name: Drawing templates shipped with Tenon
description: Makes the drawing templates in this folder: an ANSI B sheet (third-angle projection) and an ISO A3 sheet (first-angle). A new drawing can start from either (File > New Drawing from Template, or drw.new with template). Run from the repository root: tenon-cli run assets/templates/templates.json --out assets/templates

steps.note: A drawing started from a template has its standard and sheet.
